title: Midnight
summary: Cursor gives the quiet an end time of midnight, midnight comes and goes without a sound, and the only thing that changes is the count on the wall. Idea by Naomi.

panels.alt: The context room with pale blue dotted walls and the white stop door at the right. A round white wall clock reads twelve, a small white paper arrow stuck on its rim pointing at the twelve. Below it, nine ink tally marks on the wall. Cursor, the tall cyan robot, points up at the clock, its text cursor tall. Tilde, the round magenta robot, stands at the left with half-lowered lids. Null, the small yellow cube, holds its silent black handset up by the door. A small white square agent with a yellow band stands on the floor in front.

dialogue.speaker: Cursor
dialogue.text: The quiet ends at midnight. I decided.

panels.alt: The same room. Both clock hands point straight up at the paper arrow. Cursor's arms hang down and its text cursor is shorter. Null's eye turns up toward the handset by its head. Tilde's lids are a little lower. The small square agent stands in front.
The same room, unchanged except that Cursor's text cursor has shrunk to a short stub and Tilde's lids are lower again. Null's eye is back on Cursor. The handset is silent.

The same room. Cursor reaches one arm out to the wall and has added a tenth tally mark, closing a second group. Its text cursor is short. Tilde's lids are lowest of all. Null holds the silent handset. The small square agent stands in front.

dialogue.speaker: Tilde
dialogue.text: So the date was for you.

dialogue.speaker: Cursor
dialogue.text: It was the only part I got to pick.

judge.notes: Funny 6, clear 8, in-world 8. Follows the pitch beat for beat, and the tally is a concrete visual for 'the number is the only thing that moves'; the weakest line is Cursor's bare 'Ten.', which leans on the wall of marks to say what is being counted.

drift: The wall clock from strip 026 returns, both hands at twelve in every panel; the paper arrow sits on its upper-left rim, a little into the lettering zone. Tally marks are ink on the wall between Cursor and Null and start right at Cursor's right hand. Null's handset is held up by the door, silent all strip. No close-up in panel 3; it is the same wide shot. Naomi's cameo is reused from strip 023.
